market_view: VIX is calm at 16.9, but oil is whipsawing on US-Iran headlines and gold, uranium and copper are weak with 10-year yields near highs. Chips are volatile after a sharp 5-day drop in the sector ETF.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI jumped 4% on the Iran deal 'over' and tanker attacks, but XOM fell 0.4% and the move is already priced. The headline path is two-sided and uncertain; no durable edge for XOM.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold is down 23% from its high, with high yields and a firm dollar. NEM is below its 200-day average. The Newmont headlines are valuation commentary, not a catalyst.

chips.reasoning: The sector fell 9.6% in 5 days but is up 36% in 60. No concrete catalyst for NVDA; the Micron and Nvidia headlines are corporate blog items. Earnings season adds variance.

pharma.reasoning: LLY is near its high with no named catalyst. The headlines (eye-drop recall, ACA premiums, PFAS) do not concern LLY.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper is falling and FCX is down 8.6% in 5 days. The uranium export headlines (Australia-India) help uranium, not FCX. The 'Trump nuclear boom' story is general.

would_change_my_mind: A concrete scheduled catalyst (an earnings beat, a regulator decision or a confirmed supply shock) tied directly to the leader stock.

handoff.what_changed: The Iran storyline escalated: Trump said the deal is over, tankers were attacked near Hormuz and WTI rose 4.4% to 73.5. Chips dropped sharply over 5 days (ETF -9.6%), while pharma reached near highs. No concrete catalyst for any leader; all families remain flat.

oil_gas.why: Oil is whipsawing on US-Iran headlines and XOM did not follow the 4% crude jump; no durable edge.

gold_miners.why: Gold is in a downtrend with high yields and no NEM-specific catalyst.

chips.why: Sector pullback after a big run, but no named catalyst for NVDA.

pharma.why: LLY is near its high and no news relates to it.

copper_uranium.why: Copper is weak and uranium export news does not help FCX.

open_storylines.note: 10-year at 4.57% near its high, gold -23% from its peak; watch the jobs report and Fed tone.

open_storylines.note: Australia-India export deal, US nuclear push; uranium ETF still -18% in 60 days, CCJ below its 200-day average.

handoff.next_job: Next decision day: read the new handoff, re-check the five families, and look for concrete catalysts (Q2 earnings from mid-July, TSMC sales, jobs report, any Iran or Hormuz escalation). Stay flat unless a named reason appears.
